payload.summary: Copy and naming inconsistencies that undercut the product's own safety vocabulary
payload.detail: ui-copy.ts:84 titles the prescribing mode 'Medication Guidance' in a product whose banners read 'not clinical guidance' and 'not validated decision support'; suggest 'Medication Reference'. ui-copy.ts:65 gives Differentials the subtitle 'Match your catalogue to your library.', which says nothing about differential diagnosis. A conservative refusal still advertises 'CITED DOCUMENTS - 3 cited'; suggest 'Documents searched'. A 'DO NOW' card numbers four teaching observations as if they were actions, and 87 of 556 multi-item sections have a summary that is a space-join of their items with no punctuation. All clinical wording - for a human.
